chapter: Funerals, dances and the end of the parades
title: What second liners asked bands to play
summary: Second liners wanted jazz and blues, not sentimental or classical pieces, and White picnic-goers are described by rooftop and decent sections.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Say, did the guys in the second lines ever ask the bands for tunes?
Did the fellas in the second lines ever ask a band for a tune? Yeah. What did they like? What kind of numbers did they like?

Man, they used to like all kinds. I'm going to tell you what the more they didn't like. They didn't like no sentimental pieces at all. Nothing but jazz. All jazz. No sentimental pieces at all. Like the blues and all the different, you know, different numbers. That's what they wanted. They never did bother with.
